en.headline: Belt and Road Summit closes with record 60-plus MOUs
en.dek: The two-day government-organised event drew more than 6,200 participants from over 70 countries and regions and deals valued above US$3.1 billion.
body: The 11th Belt and Road Summit closed on Thursday after two days in Hong Kong, with the government saying the gathering produced a record of more than 60 memoranda of understanding.

A government statement issued on Friday night said more than 6,200 government and business leaders from over 70 countries and regions attended. Organisers showcased more than 300 investment projects and arranged over 800 one-on-one deal-making meetings. The combined value of the MOUs and of projects and deals finalised before and during the summit exceeded US$3.1 billion.

Chief Executive John Lee spoke at the opening session. Visiting speakers included Uzbekistan’s Prime Minister Abdulla Aripov, Uruguay’s Vice-President Carolina Cosse and Laos’s Deputy Prime Minister Saleumxay Kommasith. Day two featured a special address by Teresa Cheng, secretary-general of the International Organization for Mediation.

The Commerce and Economic Development Bureau said the summit also included a “GoGlobal” chapter and sessions on the low-altitude economy and on Middle East and African markets. Officials described the event as a platform for policy coordination, infrastructure connectivity, trade, finance and people-to-people exchanges under the Belt and Road Initiative.

zh.headline: 一帶一路高峰論壇閉幕 簽署逾60份合作備忘錄創新高
zh.dek: 為期兩日的論壇吸引來自70多個國家及地區逾6,200名政商代表，連同會前及會期成交，涉及金額逾31億美元。
body: 由特區政府主辦的第11屆一帶一路高峰論壇周四結束。政府周五深夜公布，論壇促成超過60份合作備忘錄，數量創歷屆新高。
聲明指，論壇匯聚來自70多個國家及地區逾6,200名政府及商界代表，展示逾300個投資項目，並安排超過800場一對一配對會議。備忘錄連同會前及會期敲定的項目及交易，總值逾31億美元。
行政長官李家超在開幕環節致辭。出席的外國官員包括烏茲別克斯坦總理阿立波夫、烏拉圭副總統科塞，以及老撫副總理沙倫賽。論壇翌日亦有國際調解院秘書長鄭若驊發表專題演講。
商務及經濟發展局表示，今屆論壇設有「企業出海」環節，以及低空經濟、中東及非洲市場等專場。當局形容論壇為推進政策溝通、設施聯通、貿易暢通、資金融通及民心相通的平台。
